items.headline: Yemen me bus-truck par hamla, 26 mare
items.detail: Somvaar ko Yemen ke Lahj prant me bus aur truck par hawai hamle me 26 log mare gaye — 12 Houthi ladake aur 14 nagrik; hamle ke liye Houthi Saudi ko aur sarkar Houthi ko zimmedaar thahra rahi hai.
items.exam_angle: Yemen griha yuddh, Saudi-Houthi — UPSC IR

items.headline: Philippines ko America se $2.4 arab raksha sauda
items.detail: Philippines ke raksha mantri ne pushti ki America $2 arab ke vitt aur $40 crore ke anudan se samvedansheel raksha hathiyaar bechega; Dakshin Cheen Sagar me raksha kshamata badhegi.
items.exam_angle: America-Philippines raksha sauda, Dakshin Cheen Sagar — UPSC IR

items.headline: Shanghai ke party pramukh Chen Jining jaanch me
items.detail: China ki sarkari Xinhua ne kaha Shanghai ke party pramukh aur Politburo sadasya Chen Jining 'gambhir anushasan ullanghan' ke sandeh me jaanch ke dayre me hain; 2025 se chauthe Politburo sadasya par jaanch.
items.exam_angle: China ki rajneeti, Xi ka bhrashtachar-virodhi abhiyan — UPSC IR

items.headline: Riyadh ke vittiya jile ki tower par hamla
items.detail: Saudi netritva wale gathbandhan ne kaha Riyadh ke King Abdullah Financial District ki tower par 'aatankwadi hamla' hua; 11 log ghayal hue jinme 2 Bharatiya bhi hain, Civil Defence ne bataya.
items.exam_angle: Houthi-Saudi tanaav, West Asia — UPSC IR
items.image_credit: Faisal Arif, CC BY-SA 4.0, Wikimedia Commons

items.headline: Hormuz me chautha tanker bhi mine se takraya
items.detail: Update: Mangalvaar ko Hormuz ke poorvi hisse me chautha tanker bhi mine se takrakar aag ki lapet me aa gaya; IRGC ke mutabik pichhle 24 ghante me 5 jahaz mine se takraye, jabki UK samudri agency ne 3 jahazon par hamle ki pushti ki.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz — duniya ki tel supply ka raasta

items.headline: Ukraine ne Russia ki refinery par hamla kiya
items.detail: Ukraine ke General Staff ne pushti ki 23 November ko drone hamle me Perm ki Lukoil refinery, Rostov ki Novoshakhtinsk refinery aur Tatarstan ke Kaleykino pumping station ko nuksan pahuncha; Perm refinery seema se lagbhag 1,500 km door hai.
items.exam_angle: Ukraine-Russia yuddh, tel par hamle — UPSC IR

items.headline: Gaza me Hamas suraksha pramukh mara gaya
items.detail: Mangalvaar ko Gaza City me Israeli drone hamle me Hamas ke internal security pramukh Naeem Abu Nahel samet 7 log mare gaye; IDF aur Shin Bet ne hamle ki pushti ki.
items.exam_angle: Gaza yuddhaviram ke bawjood hamle — West Asia tanaav

items.headline: Landmine se hatahat 5 saal me sabse zyada
items.detail: Landmine Monitor 2026 ke mutabik 2025 me 6,929 log mare ya ghayal hue — 5 saal me sabse zyada; 84% nagrik, aadhe bachche; Myanmar (1,891) aur Syria (1,602) sabse aage.
items.exam_angle: Landmine Monitor 2026, Mine Ban Treaty — UPSC IR

items.headline: Serbia school me golibari, 2 ghayal
items.detail: Kragujevac ke First Technical School me 17 saal ke chhatra ne rifle se goli chalayi; ek karmchari ko goli lagi, dusra kanch se ghayal hua, koi chhatra ghayal nahi hua aur hamlaawar giraftaar hai.

items.headline: Sanofi kharedega Insmed, $41 billion ka sauda
items.detail: France ki Sanofi ne America ki Insmed ko $41 billion me khareedne ka samjhauta kiya, saans ki bimariyon ki dawaon ke liye; sauda 2027 ki pehli chhamahi me band hone ki ummeed hai.
items.exam_angle: Teen saal ki sabse badi pharma deal — economy

items.headline: Uttar Korea: Swiss karyalaya band karne ki dhamki
items.detail: Kim Yo-jong ne Songdowon bachchon ke shivir par Swiss pratibandh ko 'khula shatrutapurna kaam' bataya aur Pyongyang me Switzerland ka rajnaitik karyalaya band karne ki dhamki di.
items.exam_angle: Uttar Korea-Switzerland, bachchon ka sthanantaran — UPSC IR

items.headline: Prince William ke ghar me ghuspaith, 2 giraftaar
items.detail: Somvaar raat Sandringham estate ke Anmer Hall me ghuspaith par 2 log burglary aur trespass ke sandeh me giraftaar hue; ghar khaali tha, William-Kate maujood nahi the.

items.headline: Lebanon par Israel ke hamle, koi hatahat nahi
items.detail: Mangalvaar ko Israel ne America ki madhyasthata wale samjhaute ke bawjood dakshin Lebanon ke Nabatieh, Marjayoun, Bint Jbeil aur Tyre jilon me hawai hamle aur golabari ki; Lebanon ki sarkari news agency NNA ke mutabik koi hatahat nahi hua.

items.headline: Iraq ne Kurdistan ke tel-kshetra par kabza liya
items.detail: PM Ali al-Zaidi ne tel taskari jaanch ke baad Kurdistan ke saare border crossing aur 4 pranton ke tel-kshetra sanghiya niyantran me lene ka aadesh diya; Kurdistan ke PM ne is faisle ko kharij kar diya.
items.exam_angle: Iraq-Kurdistan tel vivad - West Asia IR

items.headline: Yemen me August se 3.6 lakh visthapit
items.detail: UN ke mutabik August se Yemen me ladai ke kaaran 3.6 lakh se zyada log visthapit hue; 323 nagrik hatahat hue, jinme 76 ki maut hui.
items.exam_angle: Yemen manaviya sankat, UNHCR — UPSC IR

items.headline: Gaza hamle me 6 mare, 5 ghayal
items.detail: Mangalvaar ko Khan Younis police chauki par hamle me 3 aur Netzarim ke paas 3 log mare gaye; 5 ghayal hue.
items.exam_angle: Gaza yuddhviram ke baad bhi hamle — manaviya sthiti

items.headline: Norway-Ukraine: naya DESNA raksha system
items.detail: Norway aur Ukraine ne drone-rodhi DESNA vayu-raksha system par sahyog badhaya; Ukrainian missile aur Kongsberg control se bana system pehle se istemal me hai.
items.exam_angle: Drone-rodhi vayu raksha, NATO sahyog — UPSC defence

items.headline: Huckabee: Israel ko madad saal-ant tak jaari?
items.detail: America ke Israel rajdoot Huckabee ne kaha saal ke ant tak $3.8 arab ki sainya madad band hone par unhe sandeh hai; samjhauta 2028 tak chalta hai aur Congress ki manzoori zaroori hai.
items.exam_angle: America-Israel sainya madad, MoU 2028 — UPSC IR

items.headline: Merz: Europe Russia se baat ko taiyaar
items.detail: German Chancellor Merz ne kaha Europe Russia se Ukraine par vaarta ko taiyaar hai; salahakar-stariya baatcheet jaldi Abu Dhabi me phir ho sakti hai.
items.exam_angle: Ukraine shanti vaarta, Abu Dhabi — UPSC IR

items.headline: Colombia me car bomb, governor karyalaya tabah
items.detail: Villavicencio me Meta governor karyalaya ke paas car bomb phata, darjanon log ghayal hue, koi maut nahi; rashtrapati ne drug taskaron ko zimmedaar thahraya.

items.headline: UAE me bus-truck takkar, 11 mare
items.detail: Ras Al Khaimah me Al Watan Road par bus aur truck ki takkar me 11 log mare; jaanch jaari hai.

items.headline: Trump ne Iowa visfot par rok lagayi
items.detail: Rashtrapati Trump ne Iowa plant me zehrele lead azide ke visfot ko adalat ke faisle tak rokne ka aadesh diya.

items.headline: Hanoi me gas visfot, 6 mare, 10 ghayal
items.detail: Hanoi me ek khane ki dukaan par subah gas visfot hua, imarat ka hissa gira aur 6 log mare gaye, 10 ghayal hue; bachav kaam jaari hai.

items.headline: Finland border par Russia ka sainya adda
items.detail: Finland ke sarkari prasarak Yle ki satellite tasveeron se pata chala Russia Finland se 60 km door Kamenka sainya adde ko dobara bana raha hai; 69th Motor Rifle Division ke liye 11,000 sainikon ki tainaati ki yojana hai.
